military-defense.quote: No. I admire Sec Kendall, but I don’t agree with this article.

We were in Germany, I was a 2Lt and we heard it on AFN radios. It was disbelief, because Art had been extended in Korea past his end of tour as his replacement hadn’t arrived. His wife Marcia and two kids were still living at West Point, where he was assigned before his Korea assignment.

For the military in Korea, it was significant and well executed. For the media as well, as they brought the importance of the story home. Yes, the president - in my view - acted correctly as part of crisis response.

I do remember. And it was especially painful for my wife and I. CPT Bonifas was my water polo coach and sponsor at West Point, and my girlfriend (now wife) always stayed at their house when she came to the Academy. Art’s wife Marcia was also our friend.
